title: Appraisal Buffer Days in Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit Extensions
content:
The appraisal buffer of a Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit extension follows the Appraisal Order on the loan file, and it adds its days to the days the Hometown Heroes extension must cover.

**Clause.** An appraisal made subject to completion or repairs adds 10 days; an appraisal not yet completed (ordered, assigned, on hold or inspected) adds 5 days; any other appraisal order, whether completed or delivered as is, under reconsideration or cancelled, adds none.

| Appraisal Order on the file | Appraisal buffer |
|---|---|
| made subject to completion or repairs | 10 days |
| not yet completed: ordered, assigned, on hold or inspected | 5 days |
| any other: completed or delivered as is, under reconsideration, or cancelled | none |

### Cases (hypothetical)

- An appraisal order completed with the value made subject to repairs: 10 days.
- An appraisal order inspected but not yet completed: 5 days.
- An appraisal order on hold: 5 days.
- An appraisal delivered as is: no buffer.
- An appraisal order under reconsideration of value: no buffer.
- A cancelled appraisal order: no buffer.
